name: MxToolbox SuperTool
what: A web lookup tool for DNS and mail: MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, blocklist status and SMTP checks against a domain or IP, with links to follow-up tests.
when: Before and after you change mail DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), when mail from your domain starts landing in spam, or when a partner says your IP is on a blocklist.
cost_note: The SuperTool lookups are free to use in the browser; MxToolbox also sells monitoring and delivery products.
example: Open the SuperTool and enter your mail domain, for example `contoso.com`.
Prefix the query to force a specific check: `dmarc:contoso.com`, `spf:contoso.com` or `blacklist:<your public mail IP>`.
Read each result row; failed or warning rows link to a page explaining the check.
Fix the record at your DNS host, wait for the TTL to expire, and run the same query again to confirm.
pitfalls: DNS results can be cached; a fix may not show until the old record's TTL has expired.
A blocklist hit on a shared IP (for example a cloud mail service) is usually the provider's to fix, not yours.
A green SPF result does not prove DMARC alignment; check DMARC separately.
